audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Boundary-uniform two-spine moment bound fails in core survival derivation; Hp-only normalization and time-dependent Corollary2 fail in semipushed regime; Green kernel and Wronskian leading constant miss factor2
limitations: Counterevidence and scope: Pages43-47 explicitly connect the false all-x bound to Bonferroni(94),(96), Cor8, Lemma17 and Theorem1. The unbarred Q and h(|v|,zeta) in(94) rule out an accelerated-time reinterpretation. Lemma13 gives t^-1, not a constant at t=L^2/N. Positive early contributions survive mixing. This establishes a core derivation error; it does not refute fixed-x Theorem1, declare Cor8 false solely from the proof, or claim a completed repair.

Counterevidence and scope: Time-independent Pi convergence survives. Main theorems explicitly assume Hfp, where w_L N->0. Thus an added range restriction repairs this auxiliary extension; it is not a main-regime counterexample.

Counterevidence and scope: Scaling fundamental solutions cannot change the jump; speed-measure conventions conflict with the stated density. Under Hfp the corrected inverse Wronskian still has orderN used in Lemmas11-12; no changed final variance or failure of those order estimates follows. Unread handbook page19 remains unread; W0 is only algebraic calibration.

Counterevidence and scope: The original compactness argument is invalid but the claimed norm order is established by the local replacement, sufficient for the specified eigenfunction dependency. No new numerical run or interval certificate claimed.
Not claimed: Main fixed-x theorem falsity
Not claimed: Cor8 falsity solely from invalid proof
Not claimed: Absence of any author correction
Not claimed: External handbook page19 read or viewed
Not claimed: Complete repair of survival proof
Limits: Does not supply missing all-x survival argument.

repair.content:
Retain spatial initial-layer term, restrict intermediate uniformity, or prove a weighted tail argument. Full replacement core derivation not supplied.

Require Hfp for N-time normalization or use times wLt=o(1); alternatively retain exact e^(wLt) in a differently formulated limit.

Use exact G=2e^(mu(x-y))phi(min)psi(max)/omega and omega=2(xi+wL) integralpsi*vL.

Forlambda=-s^2/2, Volterra formula u=sin(sx)/s-(1/s)integral sin(s(x-y))W(y)u(y)dy. Gronwall supu<=e^(M/s)/s,error<=M e^(M/s)/s^2. Forlarges, L2sin/s>=1/(2s),error<=1/(4s); ||u||2^2>=1/(16s^2)=1/(32|lambda|). Remaining compactparameter range has positive integral by initialderivative1 andODEcontinuity.
